about_the_game:
DeepBubbles was developed by a solo developer with a passion for cozy, relaxing games. Every fish, bubble, and feature was carefully crafted during countless nights of drawing, coding, testing, and fixing. This project is the result of patience, curiosity, and a deep love for underwater aesthetics.

I sincerely hope this little world brings you a moment of peace in your day. Thank you for diving in. 🐠

short_description: Collect, feed, and evolve adorable fish in a dreamy underwater world. DeepBubbles is a relaxing idle aquarium game where you pop bubbles to gather food, complete a fish collection, and build your own peaceful ocean habitat.
